title: Zscaler UVM and Apiiro Deployment Guide

blocks.text: The Zscaler UVM and Apiiro Deployment Guide provides instructions on using Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM) features with the Apiiro platform.
The UVM solution ingests, normalizes, and unifies data across enterprise security and business systems to deliver actionable insights, analytics, and operational efficiencies.
UVM offers a preconfigured Apiiro connectors for Apiiro Secrets, which focuses on managing and securing access to sensitive information within applications.
